story_overview: Following a violent incident involving Chloe, Lena, and a man named Silas, the stoic Arthur investigates by examining a series of black-and-white photographs. Arthur confronts the now-imprisoned Silas, whose cryptic words lead Arthur to a shocking discovery back in his study.
